title: What are the common traits of top growth

messages.content: What are the common traits of top growth leaders according to Lenny?

According to Adam Fishman (00:14:22), Lenny mentioned that top growth leaders have four categories of competencies: 

1. Communication influence
2. Growth execution
3. Customer knowledge
4. Growth strategy

These categories are not exhaustive, but they are the four that Adam Fishman mentioned as being part of the growth competency model.
